# Languages

<!-- Generated by docs/languages.lua; edit nvim/lua/lang/ or nvim/lua/tools/catalog.lua, then run `mise run docs`. -->

Generated from the language files (`nvim/lua/lang/`) and the tool catalog (`nvim/lua/tools/catalog.lua`) by
`mise run docs`: don't edit it by hand. Why each tool was chosen is in
[mise-tooling-decisions.md](mise-tooling-decisions.md).

## Tools by language

Servers are language servers; formatters run through conform, in the order listed; linters run through nvim-lint.
A linter covered by a server is skipped while that server is attached to the buffer.

| Language | Filetypes | Servers | Formatters | Linters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [c](../nvim/lua/lang/c.lua) | `c`, `cpp` | `clangd` | `clang-format` | none |
| [c](../nvim/lua/lang/c.lua) | `cuda`, `objc`, `objcpp` | `clangd` | none | none |
| [cmake](../nvim/lua/lang/cmake.lua) | `cmake` | `neocmake` | `gersemi` | none |
| [css](../nvim/lua/lang/css.lua) | `css`, `scss` | `cssls` | `prettierd` | none |
| [css](../nvim/lua/lang/css.lua) | `less` | `cssls` | none | none |
| [docker](../nvim/lua/lang/docker.lua) | `dockerfile` | `docker_language_server` | none | `hadolint` |
| [fish](../nvim/lua/lang/fish.lua) | `fish` | `fish_lsp` | `fish_indent` | none |
| [go](../nvim/lua/lang/go.lua) | `go` | `gopls` | `goimports`, `gofumpt` | `golangcilint` |
| [go](../nvim/lua/lang/go.lua) | `gomod`, `gosum`, `gotmpl`, `gowork` | `gopls` | none | none |
| [html](../nvim/lua/lang/html.lua) | `html` | `html` | `prettierd` | none |
| [lua](../nvim/lua/lang/lua.lua) | `lua` | `lua_ls` | `stylua` | none |
| [make](../nvim/lua/lang/make.lua) | `make` | none | none | `checkmake` |
| [markdown](../nvim/lua/lang/markdown.lua) | `markdown` | `marksman` | `prettierd` | `markdownlint-cli2` |

| [python](../nvim/lua/lang/python.lua) | `python` | `pyrefly`, `ruff` | `ruff_fix`, `ruff_format`, `ruff_organize_imports` | `ruff` (covered by `ruff`) |

## File-scoped tools (variants)

A variant is a dotted filetype that some files of its base filetype get. It has its base's servers and linters plus
its own, and its own formatters if it names any, else its base's. Patterns are Lua patterns matched against the
file's full path.

| Filetype | Language | Files | Its own tools | About |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `c.doxygen` | [c](../nvim/lua/lang/c.lua) | none set here | none | C with Doxygen comments, from nvim-lspconfig's clangd filetypes |
| `cpp.doxygen` | [c](../nvim/lua/lang/c.lua) | none set here | none | C++ with Doxygen comments, from nvim-lspconfig's clangd filetypes |
| `hcl.docker-bake` | [docker](../nvim/lua/lang/docker.lua) | `docker-bake.hcl`, `docker-bake.override.hcl` (e.g. `docker-bake.hcl`) | server `docker_language_server` | Bake files: docker-language-server |
| `markdown.mdx` | [markdown](../nvim/lua/lang/markdown.lua) | none set here | none | MDX, from nvim-lspconfig's marksman filetypes; nothing in Neovim or this config sets it |
| `toml.pyproject` | [toml](../nvim/lua/lang/toml.lua) | `pyproject.toml` (e.g. `sub/pyproject.toml`) | formatter `pyproject-fmt` instead of `tombi` | pyproject.toml: pyproject-fmt formats it instead of tombi |
| `yaml.docker-compose` | [docker](../nvim/lua/lang/docker.lua) | pattern `compose%..+%.ya?ml`, pattern `compose%.ya?ml`, pattern `docker%-compose%..+%.ya?ml`, pattern `docker%-compose%.ya?ml` (e.g. `compose.override.yaml`) | server `docker_language_server` | Compose files: docker-language-server |
| `yaml.github-actions` | [yaml](../nvim/lua/lang/yaml.lua) | pattern `.*/%.github/workflows/[^/]*%.ya?ml` (e.g. `.github/workflows/compose.yml`) | linters `jactionlint`, `zizmor` | GitHub workflows: jactionlint, zizmor |
| `yaml.gitlab` | [yaml](../nvim/lua/lang/yaml.lua) | none set here | none | GitLab CI files, from nvim-lspconfig's yamlls filetypes |
| `yaml.helm-values` | [yaml](../nvim/lua/lang/yaml.lua) | none set here | none | Helm values files, from nvim-lspconfig's yamlls filetypes |

## Binaries

The binary behind each tool. Project copy: the dirs under a project that may hold the project's own copy, which
is used before mise's; CONTRIBUTING.md ("Tools from mise") has the whole order.

| Binary | Install | Project copy | Runtime | Provides | Languages |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bash-language-server` | `npm:bash-language-server` | none | node | server `bashls`; calls `shellcheck` | shell |
| `biome` | `biome` | `node_modules/.bin` | none | server `biome`; formatter `biome`; linter `biomejs` | web |
| `cargo-clippy` | rustup component `clippy` | none | rust | linter `clippy`; runs as `cargo` | rust |
| `checkmake` | `checkmake` | none | none | linter `checkmake` | make |
| `clang-format` | `clang-format` | none | none | formatters `clang_format`, `clang-format` | c |
| `clangd` | `github:clangd/clangd` | none | none | server `clangd` | c |
| `docker-language-server` | `github:docker/docker-language-server` | none | none | server `docker_language_server` | docker |
| `fish` | `github:fish-shell/fish-shell`, version 4.1 or later | none | none | formatter `fish_indent`; used by fish_lsp | fish |
| `fish-lsp` | `npm:fish-lsp` | none | node | server `fish_lsp`; calls `fish` | fish |
| `gersemi` | `pypi:gersemi` | `.venv/bin` | none | formatter `gersemi` | cmake |
| `gofumpt` | `gofumpt` | none | none | formatter `gofumpt` | go |
| `goimports` | `go:golang.org/x/tools/cmd/goimports` | none | go | formatter `goimports` | go |
| `golangci-lint` | `golangci-lint` | none | go | linter `golangcilint` | go |
| `gopls` | `go:golang.org/x/tools/gopls` | none | go | server `gopls` | go |
| `hadolint` | `hadolint` | none | none | linter `hadolint` | docker |
| `inotifywait` | the system's | none | none | used by pyrefly | python |
| `jactionlint` | `jactionlint` | none | none | linter `jactionlint` | yaml |
| `lua-language-server` | `lua-language-server` | none | none | server `lua_ls` | lua |
| `markdownlint-cli2` | `markdownlint-cli2` | `node_modules/.bin` | node | linter `markdownlint-cli2` | markdown |
| `marksman` | `marksman` | none | none | server `marksman` | markdown |
| `neocmakelsp` | `github:neocmakelsp/neocmakelsp` | none | none | server `neocmake` | cmake |
| `prettierd` | `npm:@fsouza/prettierd` | `node_modules/.bin` | node | formatter `prettierd` | css, docker, html, markdown, yaml |
| `pyproject-fmt` | `pypi:pyproject-fmt` | `.venv/bin` | none | formatter `pyproject-fmt` | toml |
| `pyrefly` | `pypi:pyrefly` | `.venv/bin` | none | server `pyrefly`; calls `inotifywait` | python |
| `ruff` | `ruff` | `.venv/bin` | none | server `ruff`; formatters `ruff_fix`, `ruff_format`, `ruff_organize_imports`; linter `ruff` | python |
| `rust-analyzer` | rustup component `rust-analyzer` | none | rust | server `rust_analyzer` | rust |
| `rustfmt` | rustup component `rustfmt` | none | rust | formatter `rustfmt` | rust |
| `shellcheck` | `shellcheck` | none | none | used by bashls | shell |
| `shfmt` | `shfmt` | none | none | formatter `shfmt` | shell |
| `stylua` | `stylua` | none | none | formatter `stylua` | lua |
| `terraform` | `terraform` | none | none | formatter `terraform_fmt` | terraform |
| `terraform-ls` | `terraform-ls` | none | none | server `terraformls` | terraform |
